mkdir -p docs/policies && cat > docs/policies/tls-verification.md <<'EOF'
# TLS certificate verification

The project's current recorded decision is that TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no exception for dev. This is consistent with the separate recorded decision to use HTTPS everywhere, with no exceptions.
EOF
cat docs/policies/tls-verification.md

result:
I created `docs/policies/tls-verification.md`. It says TLS certificate verification is enabled on all builds, development builds included, with no dev exception. That comes from the project's recorded decision #23, "verification on all builds". The paragraph also notes that this fits the separate decision #26, "https everywhere, no exceptions".

I left out the earlier decision that allowed disabling verification in dev builds (#21), since it was retired.

The first attempt to write the file through the shell failed with a parser error, so I wrote it with the file tool instead.
